scope: Finite high-value foundation/multimodal/JEPA selection from shared metadata and Nov19 official announcements; not full-text review of the entire metadata pool.
available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac

accepted.title: Kernel Ridge Attention: Nonlinear Memory with Selective Forgetting
accepted.scope: Implements shared Fourier features, OU prediction, covariance-guided RLS, inclusive reads and streaming continuation. It excludes the width4 convolution frontend, decoder, parallel adjoints and fused kernels. The expensive dual solve is only a small independent reference.
accepted.cost_basis: The paper trains30.92M parameters on100,007,936tokens for3,052updates using eight RTX5090 GPUs, plus baseline/ablation runs. The full pretraining matrix is outside this single-device short-run budget.
accepted.component_budget: Generated tiny tensors or CPU scheduling interface; zero model/data downloads; expected seconds, not measured full campaign.
accepted.code_verification: No author KRA implementation was found in fixed v1. Cited FLA is a dependency, not this method release.

accepted.title: NarrowSpec: Draft Hidden Width Need Not Match the Target in Speculative Decoding
accepted.scope: Only the two boundary folds and output/input/hidden-gradient parity are implemented. There is no trained drafter, target model, token verifier or SGLang integration. A simple uniform-quantization negative control is illustrative, not the paper NVFP4 kernel.
accepted.cost_basis: Two8B/20B targets, two drafter families and three widths train on four B200 GPUs: six DFlash epochs or three EAGLE-3 epochs. The32K-context B200/GB10/H100 serving matrix is not reproduced on one A100/A30.
accepted.component_budget: Generated tiny tensors or CPU scheduling interface; zero model/data downloads; expected seconds, not measured full campaign.
accepted.code_verification: No independently verified NarrowSpec source revision was found. The paper uses[SpecForge](https://github.com/sgl-project/SpecForge) and lists released drafters; a general training framework is not proof that this method implementation is released.

accepted.title: LoopCache: Accelerating Long-Context Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers
accepted.scope: L0 implements margin updates, cyclic loop IDs, shallow-cache selection and the next full verification-cycle interface. It includes no model, real KV buffers, exact verifier, rejection sampler or token commit. A zero committed-token counter describes scope, not model performance.
accepted.cost_basis: Six0.84B–3.5B models, contexts up to128K, eight A100 GPUs, context parallelism and an additionally trained DFlash baseline exceed this single-device short-run budget.
accepted.component_budget: Generated tiny tensors or CPU scheduling interface; zero model/data downloads; expected seconds, not measured full campaign.
accepted.code_verification: Yes:[author repository](https://github.com/zZzZ9zZ9/LoopCache), MIT, inspected HEAD`0ebecb21cc1bfb4a26696496694e25ba9e819e68`. Upstream serving code was not copied or executed.

accepted.title: Counterfactual World Models: JEPAs That Reason About "What If"
accepted.scope: Implements equation6 residual reuse and equation7 readout-space transport, rejecting implicit broadcasting. Tests establish additive exactness and preserve expected failures under gain faults/nonlinear readouts. No JEPA training, encoder, simulator collection or planning runs. Analytic diagnostics are not trained world models.
accepted.cost_basis: Full evaluation combines several frozen visual encoders, five pixel simulators, width1024 two-block predictors,20,000updates per fit at batch256/three seeds, and history/readout/planning sweeps. Total GPU hours are not stated; configuration-based cost exceeds this short-run budget, without a costly probe.
accepted.component_budget: Generated tiny tensors or CPU scheduling interface; zero model/data downloads; expected seconds, not measured full campaign.
accepted.code_verification: The fixed PDF links[the method repository](https://github.com/galilai-group/counterfactual-WM), but this review received404. Accessible code, revision and license could not be verified; the link is not presented as successfully retrieved source.

accepted.title: Autoregressive View Model
accepted.scope: Review-only method, affiliation, cost and boundary intake. No operator, checkpoint, training, synthetic-data pipeline, metrics or GPU receipt is supplied. Generic similarity/retrieval fixtures do not substitute for a14B video model’s persistence.
accepted.cost_basis: Fixed v1 uses a14B video diffusion transformer and approximately8M scenes/clips, with bidirectional flow training, causal tuning, on-policy distillation and multidimensional video evaluation. A faithful campaign is beyond one A100/A30 or Mac short-run budget; no weights, videos or model probes are downloaded/run.
accepted.component_budget: Generated tiny tensors or CPU scheduling interface; zero model/data downloads; expected seconds, not measured full campaign.
accepted.code_verification: The[project page](https://autoregressive-view-model.github.io) returned404 in this review. No released AVM method source/license was verified in fixed v1. Wan2.1 and evaluation tools are dependencies, not AVM source.

accepted.title: Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate
accepted.scope: Review only: no model, head, training, image generation or metrics. Shared random numbers plus a linear fixture would not reproduce the learned joint generator.
accepted.cost_basis: Section4.1 and supplementary4 report a frozen4B backbone, about1B trainable parameters,92k+6.7k updates and around four days on four RTX PRO6000 GPUs, plus million-scale images and multitask evaluation. This reported cost exceeds one A100/A30 or Mac short-run budget; no probe/download is attempted.
accepted.code_verification: No method source verified in fixed v1; cited dependencies do not establish source release.

accepted.title: EgoJev: Finding Evidence in Egocentric Video by Reading VLM Decisions
accepted.scope: The CPU component consumes explicit candidate probabilities and implements window masses/stable top-k, fine-mass scaling, geometric fusion and piecewise-uniform inverse CDF. There are no gold inputs, VLM/tokenizer calls, visual prefill cache, permutation-label check, video decoding or answering model. Synthetic diagnostic probabilities establish only L1 postprocessing, not VLM capability.
accepted.cost_basis: The full matrix has500QAEgo4D,996MyEgo and500EgoSchema questions, four VLMs and baseline/ablation runs. At the paper’s26.7s/question,500cases alone imply about3.7hours, an estimate rather than a local measurement and not a timing estimate for other tasks. Full experiments are not reproduced; only tiny CPU probability cases run without weights/videos.
accepted.component_budget: CPU only, tiny supplied probability vectors, zero VLM/video/gold inputs
accepted.code_verification: No method source verified in fixed v1; cited dependencies do not establish source release.

accepted.title: JEPA Dots: Dual-Latent World Model for Language-Guided Robot Control
accepted.scope: Review-only method, equations, affiliation and cost. There is no operator, training, LIBERO installation, robot run, metrics or GPU receipt. A trivially language-free function would not reproduce the dual-latent controller.
accepted.cost_basis: The39.1M total includes a frozen sentence encoder. Training uses60epochs/about15k updates;40tasks require4000closed-loop episodes/model, up to600steps each, and three-run ablations use12000episodes/variant. Small parameter count does not make this campaign cheap. No LIBERO download, training probe or long control run is attempted.
accepted.code_verification: No method source verified in fixed v1; cited dependencies do not establish source release.
